name: tencent-ads
description: 腾讯广告智能投放。调用 Marketing API v3.0 的营销单元接口和已钉选的智投字段；未配置 access_token 或 account_id 时不请求账户，也不创建广告。本包不是 Go SDK 二进制。

access_token.title: TENCENT_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
access_token.description: Marketing API access_token from https://api.e.qq.com/oauth/token. No default. Unset leaves 腾讯广告智能投放 unavailable. This package does not create a developer app or advertiser account.

account_id.title: TENCENT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
account_id.description: Advertiser account_id used by v3 adgroups. Integer string. No default.

api_base.title: TENCENT_ADS_API_BASE
api_base.description: Optional. Only https://api.e.qq.com/v3.0 (v3 SDK production default) or https://sandbox-api.e.qq.com/v3.0 (v3 docs sandbox base). Other hosts are rejected.

client_id.title: TENCENT_ADS_CLIENT_ID
client_id.description: Optional. Developer app id, used only by oauth-token. Not required when access_token is already set.

client_secret.title: TENCENT_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
client_secret.description: Optional. Developer app secret, used only by oauth-token. Never invented by this package.
